title: Building and Construction award, CW/ECW 2 (civil, weekly hire), ordinary hourly rate

scope.classification: Level 2 (CW/ECW 2); Weekly hire - full-time and part-time - Civil construction

qualifications.text: The rates of pay in the tables for weekly hire employees include industry allowance and tool allowance (where applicable).
When do the rates in the pay guide apply from? The first full pay period starting on or after 01 July 2026.
If our information is inconsistent with the award, then the award applies.
